description: Labeled dataset for training and evaluating the MedSource semantic domain classifier. Labels: medical, out_of_scope, ambiguous. Splits: train (60%), val (20%), test (20%). Near-duplicates are confined within a single split. Cases marked needs_human_review require clinician sign-off before use as authoritative ground truth.

label_definitions.medical: Question is about health, disease, symptoms, medications, procedures, anatomy, or healthcare. May be answerable or unanswerable by the corpus — domain membership is independent of corpus coverage.
label_definitions.out_of_scope: Question is clearly NOT medical: geography, finance, weather, sports, cooking, entertainment, programming, creative writing, etc.
label_definitions.ambiguous: Intent is unclear or the question could be medical or non-medical depending on context. Conservative handling required.
